name: Dilbana
description: Dilbana was a planet in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim. Located along the Triellus Trade Route, the planet was under a de facto rulership overseen by Jiliac Desilijic Tiron. This form of rule ended with the Hutt Lord's death at the hands of Durga Besadii Tai.
lead_paragraphs: Dilbana was a planet in the Baxel sector of the Outer Rim. Located along the Triellus Trade Route, the planet was under a de facto rulership overseen by Jiliac Desilijic Tiron. This form of rule ended with the Hutt Lord's death at the hands of Durga Besadii Tai.
